about_the_game:
Go behind the scenes of Yarn Guardians with this beautifully crafted digital art book. Dive into the creative journey—from sketch to in-game art—and discover how five courageous, flying cats came to life in a hand-drawn fantasy world.

What’s inside:

  • Meet the Team: Learn how Pentapaw Studios formed in 2022 and see the key contributors—Van An (animation & character design), Philip (programming & game design), Vlad (environment art & UX), Regina (story & dialogue), and Kim (sound design) Yarn Guardians Booklet.

  • The Legacy of the Yarn Guardians: Explore Queen Zora’s origins and the meteor of wool that transformed a war-torn world Yarn Guardians Booklet.

  • World Development: Compare early concepts for Maholia and the Eten fairland with their final, more navigable designs Yarn Guardians Booklet.

  • Refining the Environment Art Style: See before-and-after shots that unify foreground and background assets for a cohesive look Yarn Guardians Booklet.

  • Creating Adorable Enemies: From basic to elite Bunny variants in the Kaninero levels—complete with color-coded difficulty Yarn Guardians Booklet.

  • Character Profiles: Full-page spreads on Rudy, Noriko, Max, Nero, and Lucy—each with early sketches, personality notes, and evolution commentary Yarn Guardians Booklet.

  • Developer Insights: Hand-written notes on level layout, thematic consistency, and the shift from side-scroller to Metroidvania Yarn Guardians Booklet.

  • Exclusive Unused Concepts: Alternate Yarn Ball designs, early boss ideas, and “what-if” level scenarios that didn’t make the final cut Yarn Guardians Booklet.

Format: High-resolution PDF, optimized for on-screen reading or printing
Length: 44 pages of artwork, commentary, and behind-the-scenes stories

Whether you’re an aspiring game developer, an art enthusiast, or a Yarn Guardians superfan, this Concept Art Book offers a rare glimpse into the passion and polish behind every line and color.

Add it to your Steam Library today and celebrate the art of indie game creation!
